name: RootBass
description: Follows the lowest pitch in Audio In (bass-band AMDF → 12-TET A440) and plays a gated synth bass. Assumes the chord is stable within each 16th; pitch latches on step boundaries and can follow changes across steps. Featured groove is Tresillo (3+3+2). Hold to run. X = octave, Y = waveform.

params.name: OCT
params.detail: Octave offset relative to detected note (-2…+1)

params.name: RHY
params.detail: Gate pattern: HOLD, TRESI (tresillo), CINQ (cinquillo), HALF

params.name: DEC
params.detail: Amp decay after each rhythmic hit
